punchline: Julia Cameron's cure for creative block includes going to a junk store by yourself, two hours a week.
thirty_sec: Julia Cameron says art runs on images, and every time you make something you scoop them out of an inner well. Without upkeep, it runs dry. So she prescribes an artist date: about two hours a week, alone, somewhere that delights you, like a junk store, an aquarium or an old movie. No duty, no output. Think mystery, not mastery.
key_contrast: Taking in, not just giving out
